description: Every pin in the repository, proposed as one weekly pull request, each major on its own, security fixes at once. The workflow that runs it is .github/workflows/renovate.yml.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Moves what only the locks name (uv.lock, mise.lock, the npm lock) in the same Monday window; Renovate never groups it with other updates.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A fix for a known vulnerability opens at once, outside the schedule and the limit, all open fixes in one pull request.

packageRules.description: Everything short of a major moves together, digests included, so a week's updates are one pull request.
A new Python or Go minor is a new language version that the matrix, the target versions and go.mod move with, so it comes on its own like a major.
requires-python, engines and the go directive say what the project supports, not what it runs, so they stay ranges.
uv's mise pin and the images' uv move in one pull request; checks:toolchain fails while they differ.
mise records a github: tool's version without the tag's leading v.
The CodeQL bundle's releases are tagged codeql-bundle-v<version> beside the action's own tags; checks:codeql-bundle holds it to the bundle the pinned action runs.
The vendored API reference bundle is replaced, not edited: the script fetches the new version, checks its integrity and records its digests.

customManagers.description: The mise release CI installs, which min_version decides; mise's own manager reads only the tools.
The vendored API reference bundle, by the version UPSTREAM records.
The Trivy release the image scans run.
The hosted runner image, so a new one moves toolchain.env with every runs-on in the same pull request.
The Cordon commit admission signs and verifies with, followed on its main branch.
The Renovate image the workflow runs, by version and digest.
